svg.aria-label: Domain-locked expert memory — three specialized agents each accumulating knowledge within their own domain boundary
svg.title: Domain-Locked Expert Memory
svg.desc: Three specialized agents (Backend Dev, QA Engineer, Security Reviewer) each bounded within their own dashed domain zone. Each agent has a growing stack of domain-specific memory items. Animation: 15s cycle — left-to-right column reveal with items stacking up, pulse highlights, breathe and reset.

g.text: Each agent builds knowledge only in its domain
AGENTS STAY IN THEIR LANE · KNOWLEDGE STAYS FOCUSED
